base_prompt:
A high-end stylised 3D animated feature film, cinematic and colourful, family comedy-adventure tone, expressive cartoon character animation with squash-and-stretch, detailed fur and fabric, soft global illumination, rich saturated colour, shallow depth of field, anamorphic widescreen framing, smooth professional camera work.
Setting: a cavernous chamber so comprehensively grey that even the shadows are grey, with a reinforced steel cage at its centre. Lighting: cold flat grey light, a single spotlight on the cage.
In the shot: Marvel, an ancient, kindly, slightly stooped wizard with a huge floor-length grey beard tinged with patches of green moss, bushy eyebrows, twinkling eyes, patchwork robes stitched from three different historical eras (medieval velvet, Victorian brocade, 1970s paisley), an absurdly tall pointed wizard hat that nearly scrapes the ceiling, and a gnarled wooden staff; Ben Elf, a tiny elf about the height of a teacup, neat and bright-eyed, wearing a pointed green hat, a green jacket with eleven unnecessary pockets, and a belt hung with a small brass horn, a spare horn, a scroll, a magnifying glass, a bag of mixed nuts and a laminated official ID card; Princess Holly, a tiny fairy princess about the height of a teacup, with a shimmering fairy-pink dress, iridescent wings like soap bubbles that catch the light, a little silver tiara, rosy cheeks, and a slender wand that fizzes with small irregular pink sparks; Tomkin, an anthropomorphic tabby cat who walks upright, slim and wiry, with burnt-orange "artisanal copper" fur and darker copper tiger stripes, bright emerald-green eyes, long expressive whiskers, a smug confident half-smile, brass welding goggles pushed up on his forehead, and a leather tool belt full of tiny gadgets.
Camera: Wide, the team entering.
Action: Marvel opens a heavy door with a quiet clicking spell; Ben announces them with a horn blast, Holly trips slightly, and Tomkin strides in with measured confidence.
No dialogue.
Sound effects: lock click, horn toot, small stumble, echoing footsteps, ambience of low hum, squirrel chittering echoing.
Audio: dialogue and sound effects only, no background music, no narrator other than the characters speaking. No subtitles, no captions, no readable on-screen text.
